findings.title: Dual Configuration Formats for Self-Improvement Policy

evidence.observation: Both JSON and YAML formats exist simultaneously for self-improvement policy configuration
YAML policy file coexists alongside JSON policy file without clear precedence

proposed_action.description: Standardize self-improvement policy configuration onto a single canonical format and eliminate the redundant configuration file.

findings.expected_benefit: Prevents configuration drift and ambiguity over policy enforcement precedence.

findings.title: Uncommitted Changes Across Core Engineering and Self-Improvement Modules

evidence.observation: Repository working tree is dirty with uncommitted changes in core/engineering/batch_coding.py, scripts/self_improvement/auto_remediation.py, scripts/self_improvement/decision_processor.py, and data/self-improvement/review/decisions.jsonl

proposed_action.description: Review, test, and commit or stash pending modifications in batch coding and self-improvement remediation pipelines.

findings.expected_benefit: Ensures reproducibility, clean CI/CD baseline, and proper audit trail for autonomous remediation changes.
